verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a real API covering agent create/update (including call summary toggles), extraction categories, placing calls and fetching transcripts, and workflows run entirely through the API, plus a CLI and MCP server for agents, calls, numbers and batches. However, nothing documents full UI parity: provider integrations are connected from the dashboard's Settings → Integrations, API keys are created via a dashboard button, Agent Studio is presented as a UI feature, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of provider integrations, API-key management and Agent Studio, and a published OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: driven entirely through the Bolna API
call_summary_enabled (boolean, off by default) on the agent create and update APIs
POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories — create a category (name + model) and attach it to an agent
lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal — no dashboard tab required.
